== Title ==
<span lang="ja">九死に一生</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">能力値＞2の反乱軍がいる位置カードで 戦闘が始まった直後なら、そこにいる自分のキャラクターを全員移動させることにより（移動コストは通常どおり） 戦闘をキャンセルできる。全員を移動させられる場合にしか使用できない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">戦闘時、外壁破損の際、あるいは保安上の判断で ブラスト ドアは区画を封鎖する。厚いドアはブラスター ライフルの銃火を寄せ付けない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Narrow Escape]].

'''Lore''' — In battle, when the outer hull is breached, or as a security decision, blast doors seal off compartments. Thick doors keep blaster-rifle fire away.

'''Game text''' — Just after a battle starts at a location card where a Rebel of ability > 2 is present, cancel the battle by moving all your characters there. Pay movement cost as usual. Use only if all of them can move.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese may be used only if all of those characters can move.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-narrowescape-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Narrow Escape]].</ref>
